quantization: W-BFP5 / Top-2 A-BiE5 G16 fake quantization with independent per-activation-tensor percentile-grid Top-2 reconstruction-MSE thresholds
method_label: Top-2 activation-only BiE tensor-wise exact P95-P99 threshold grid search
format: W-BFP5 (1S4M + one E5, G16); Top-2 A-BiE5 (1S4M + two E5 + per-value type bit, G16)

threshold_contract.applies_to: activation only; weights use single-exponent BFP
threshold_contract.exponent_mapping: float64 log2(exact FP16 percentile value); zero uses -128.0 sentinel
threshold_contract.selection: independent argmin activation tensor reconstruction MSE after Top-2 demotion
threshold_contract.top2_rule: for each G16 block keep up to two above-threshold values with largest abs; ties use lower K index; demote others before normal shared exponent selection
threshold_contract.activation_granularity: one nn.Linear input tensor across all calibration calls
threshold_contract.threshold_storage: float64 log2 exponent per activation tensor

activation_block_outlier_profile.histogram_semantics: index k = G16 activation blocks with exactly k threshold candidates or encoded outliers
